intro: Run one shared command-based poll across Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and TikTok directly from the existing THSV chat intakes. No separate Streamer.bot commands or triggers are required.

sections.title: 1. Turn on universal polls
sections.notice: Keep the default ! prefix for the easiest setup. Opening and closing are announced to all four supported chats; vote confirmations remain in the viewer's source chat.

sections.title: 2. Choose how polls run
sections.notice: Moderator: !poll open Best snack? | Cookies | Chips. Viewers vote with !vote 1. Set the timer to 0 when you prefer closing with !poll close.

sections.title: 3. Keep the poll small and readable
sections.notice: Compact is recommended. The poll stays in one translucent card and updates its bars without repeatedly disappearing or covering the stream.

sections.title: 4. Match your stream
sections.notice: The default glass background is 72% opaque, allowing gameplay and overlays behind it to remain visible.

sections.title: Advanced: change command names
sections.notice: Change these only when another command already uses the same name. The names must remain different.
